title: Node Compare
description: Two nodes side by side, for the same-signal test (T3) and the two-node run (S1).

list.name: node_a
list.label: Node A
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
union(tables: [
  schema.tagValues(bucket: "waveform_1s", tag: "node_id", start: -1d,
    predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "voltage" and r._field == "frames"),
  schema.tagValues(bucket: "telemetry", tag: "node_id", start: -1d,
    predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r._field == "dt_ns")
])
  |> group()
  |> unique()
  |> sort()

list.name: node_b
list.label: Node B
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
union(tables: [
  schema.tagValues(bucket: "waveform_1s", tag: "node_id", start: -1d,
    predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "voltage" and r._field == "frames"),
  schema.tagValues(bucket: "telemetry", tag: "node_id", start: -1d,
    predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r._field == "dt_ns")
])
  |> group()
  |> unique()
  |> sort()

list.name: phase
list.label: Phase
list.query: A : a, B : b, C : c

panels.title: Status

targets.query:
from(bucket: "waveform")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "daq2_packet" and (r.node_id == "${node_a}" or r.node_id == "${node_b}") and r._field == "sequence")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "node_id"])
  |> group(columns: ["node_id"])

panels.description: Online if the node's newest full-rate packet is under 30 s old.

panels.title: PTP

targets.query:
import "math"
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and (r.node_id == "${node_a}" or r.node_id == "${node_b}") and r.subsystem == "ptp_status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "locked" or r._field == "state" or r._field == "offset_ns")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "node_id"])
  |> group(columns: ["node_id"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, node_id: r.node_id, _value:
      if r.locked == 1.0 then 2.0
      else if r.state == 2.0 and math.abs(x: r.offset_ns) < 100000.0 then 1.0
      else 0.0}))

panels.description: Locked: servo within 1 us of the grandmaster for 8 Syncs. Both nodes must be locked to compare them.

panels.title: Completeness

targets.query:
import "array"
pct = (node) => {
  pk = from(bucket: "waveform")
    |> range(start: -65s, stop: -5s)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "daq2_packet" and r.node_id == node)
  received = (pk |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "frames") |> sum() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._value
  lo = (pk |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "first_index") |> min() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._value
  hi = (pk |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "first_index") |> max() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._value
    + (pk |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "frames") |> last() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._value
  return array.from(rows: [{node_id: node, _value: 100.0 * float(v: received) / float(v: hi - lo)}])
}
union(tables: [pct(node: "${node_a}"), pct(node: "${node_b}")])
  |> group(columns: ["node_id"])

panels.description: Frames stored as a share of frames acquired, over the minute to 5 s ago, from the packet frame indices.

panels.title: Overlay: ${quantity:text}, phase ${phase:text} (latest 60 ms)

targets.query:
lastTime = (node) => (from(bucket: "waveform")
  |> range(start: -12s, stop: -2s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${quantity}" and r.node_id == node and r._field == "${phase}")
  |> last()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._time
ta = int(v: lastTime(node: "${node_a}"))
tb = int(v: lastTime(node: "${node_b}"))
stop = time(v: if ta < tb then ta else tb)
start = time(v: int(v: stop) - 60000000)
from(bucket: "waveform")
  |> range(start: start, stop: time(v: int(v: stop) + 1))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${quantity}" and (r.node_id == "${node_a}" or r.node_id == "${node_b}") and r._field == "${phase}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: r._value) / 1000.0, node_id: r.node_id}))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["node_id"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with t_ms: float(v: int(v: r._time) - int(v: start)) / 1000000.0}))
  |> drop(columns: ["_time"])

panels.description: Both nodes' samples over the same 60 ms at the full ~30 kHz, ending ~2 s ago. With the same signal on both inputs the traces should lie on top of each other.

panels.title: RMS per second: ${quantity:text}, phase ${phase:text}
panels.description: Per-second RMS from waveform_1s (V or A). A steady gap between the nodes is a gain difference, which does not affect T3.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "waveform_1s")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${quantity}" and (r.node_id == "${node_a}" or r.node_id == "${node_b}") and r._field == "${phase}_rms")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.node_id}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

panels.title: DC mean per second: ${quantity:text}, phase ${phase:text}
panels.description: Per-second mean (V or A): each board's offset. The T3 panel removes it.

panels.title: Ingest losses (all nodes)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "waveform_1s")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "daq2_ingest")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "gap_frames" or r._field == "invalid_time" or r._field == "mqtt_drops" or r._field == "buffer_drop_lines" or r._field == "write_errors")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sum()

panels.description: Totals over the dashboard time range from daq2-ingest's stats, across every node. All should be 0.

panels.title: Ingest latency (all nodes)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "waveform_1s")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "daq2_ingest" and r._field =~ /^latency_(mqtt|stored)_p(50|99)_ms$/)
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field:
      if r._field == "latency_mqtt_p50_ms" then "Arrival, median"
      else if r._field == "latency_mqtt_p99_ms" then "Arrival, 99th pct"
      else if r._field == "latency_stored_p50_ms" then "Stored, median"
      else if r._field == "latency_stored_p99_ms" then "Stored, 99th pct"
      else r._field}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.description: Delay from each full-rate packet's newest sample to its arrival over MQTT, and to InfluxDB confirming its write, from daq2-ingest's 10 s stats (worst worker in each interval). Needs the server clock synchronised to the grandmaster; negative values mean it isn't.
